revision: Short industry motivation with primary Mastercard and Visa references
purpose: Motivate travel-agent payment completeness; no product validation or novelty claim
paragraph:
Mastercard's Agent Pay announcement uses flight, hotel, and transportation
bookings to illustrate the need for visibility into agent-initiated
payments~\cite{mastercard2026}. Visa's shopping benchmark examines whether
agents discover and satisfy customer requirements; checkout and payment testing
are planned extensions~\cite{visa2026}. An agent can choose the right hotel
while leaving a payment unresolved, or choose the wrong hotel while every
payment is accounted for. TrustBound studies payment completeness.

sources.author: Mastercard
sources.title: Mastercard Advances Agentic Commerce With New Trust and Intelligence Services

sources.author: Visa
sources.title: Visa Releases First-of-Its-Kind Industry Benchmark for AI Shopping; Almost Half of Test Runs Fail

source_classification: Two company announcements, not peer-reviewed research; retrieved 10 November 2026
visa_scope: Shopping requirement discovery and purchase decisions; checkout, payment and order-placement testing described as planned extensions. No benchmark failure statistic is presented as a payment-completeness failure rate.
